name: holdout_detector_disjoint_v1
description: Detector-disjoint holdout subset — 6 cases whose inconsistent claims were discovered by external sources (PubPeer/correction notices) and whose anomaly types (label_swap / misaligned_records / mislabeled_panel / provenance_mismatch / assignment_inconsistency / pseudoreplication) are NOT covered by the duplicate-column / fixed-offset / paired-ratio / cross-sheet-reuse detector family. Use to test whether B3 FAR generalises beyond the detector's training distribution. NOTE: ncb_aldometanib was REMOVED after w1 verification (2026-07-18) — its 'undocumented_derivation' anomaly is mechanically a constant offset (liver-tumour = +0.908 on the dirty locus, -1.1 on the clean locus); on the real multi-cell series (Fig4m!C4:C12 vs FigS10a!C4:C12) the fixed-offset detector FIRES, so it belongs to the detector family, not to the disjoint holdout. See holdout_detector_disjoint_v1_results.json.
